run-physical-resources.lisp:
; Atomic acquisition: no request waits while retaining half a page bundle.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "run-physical-state")
(include-book "machines-b")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(defun fn2-run-load-reserve (c kind owner generation fn2-run-loads fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-loads fn2-pool)
 :guard (and (fn2-run-loads-wfp fn2-run-loads) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp c) (< c (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads))
                    (equal (fn2-run-loads-phase c fn2-run-loads) *fn2-run-load-phase-idle*)
                    (fn2-pool-mrefp kind owner generation)))
       (mv :state fn2-run-loads fn2-pool))
      (pc (fn2-pool-class-for *fn2-format-page-size* fn2-pool))
      (sc (fn2-pool-class-for *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* fn2-pool))
      ((unless (and (natp pc) (< pc (fn2-pool-nclasses fn2-pool))
                    (natp sc) (< sc (fn2-pool-nclasses fn2-pool))
                    (if (equal pc sc) (<= 2 (fn2-pool-class-countsi pc fn2-pool))
                     (and (< 0 (fn2-pool-class-countsi pc fn2-pool)) (< 0 (fn2-pool-class-countsi sc fn2-pool))))))
       (mv :exhausted fn2-run-loads fn2-pool))
      ((mv admission fn2-run-loads) (fn2-run-load-admission-begin fn2-run-loads))
      ((unless (eq admission :ok)) (mv admission fn2-run-loads fn2-pool))
      ((mv code page pgen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve pc kind owner generation fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-loads fn2-pool))
      (fn2-run-loads (fn2-run-loads-put c (phase *fn2-run-load-phase-uncertain*) (lease-mode *fn2-run-load-lease-mode-owned*) (borrow-token 0) (windows 1)
       (kind kind) (owner owner) (generation generation) (page page) (page-gen pgen) (scratch *fn2-none*) (scratch-gen 0) (pending 0)))
      ((mv code scratch sgen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve sc kind owner generation fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok))
       (b* (((unless (fn2-pool-release-countp page fn2-pool)) (mv :recovery-required fn2-run-loads fn2-pool))
            ((mv release fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-release page pgen kind owner generation fn2-pool)))
        (let ((fn2-run-loads (if (member-eq release '(:ok :retired))
                             (fn2-run-loads-put c (phase *fn2-run-load-phase-idle*) (windows 0) (tag 0)
                              (kind 0) (owner 0) (generation 0)) fn2-run-loads)))
         (mv (if (member-eq release '(:ok :retired)) code :recovery-required) fn2-run-loads fn2-pool))))
      (fn2-run-loads (fn2-run-loads-put c (phase *fn2-run-load-phase-reserved*) (lease-mode *fn2-run-load-lease-mode-owned*) (borrow-token 0)
       (kind kind) (owner owner) (generation generation) (windows 2) (page page) (page-gen pgen)
       (scratch scratch) (scratch-gen sgen) (pending 0) (sector 0) (copied 0))))
  (mv :ok fn2-run-loads fn2-pool)))

(defun fn2-run-load-checker-init (c prefix fn2-run-loads)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-loads :measure (nfix (- (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads) (nfix c)))
 :guard (and (fn2-run-loads-wfp fn2-run-loads) (natp c) (natp prefix))))
 (if (>= (nfix c) (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads)) fn2-run-loads
  (let ((fn2-run-loads (if (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ prefix c))
                       (fn2-run-loads-set-checker c (+ prefix c) fn2-run-loads) fn2-run-loads)))
   (fn2-run-load-checker-init (+ c 1) prefix fn2-run-loads))))
(defun fn2-run-load-profile-init (profile fn2-run-loads)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-loads
 :guard (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile))
             (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ 4 (fn2-b-upload-windows profile) (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile))))))
 (let ((fn2-run-loads (fn2-run-loads-init (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile) fn2-run-loads)))
  (fn2-run-load-checker-init 0 (+ 4 (fn2-b-upload-windows profile)) fn2-run-loads)))

(fn2-run-load-frames fn2-run-load-reserve
 (c kind owner generation fn2-run-loads fn2-pool)
 (fn2-run-loads fn2-pool)
 ((fn2-run-loads 1) (fn2-pool 2)))

(defun fn2-run-load-roomp (n fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-pool :guard (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
 (let ((pc (fn2-pool-class-for *fn2-format-page-size* fn2-pool))
       (sc (fn2-pool-class-for *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* fn2-pool)))
  (and (natp n) (natp pc) (< pc (fn2-pool-nclasses fn2-pool))
       (natp sc) (< sc (fn2-pool-nclasses fn2-pool))
       (if (equal pc sc) (<= (* 2 n) (fn2-pool-class-countsi pc fn2-pool))
        (and (<= n (fn2-pool-class-countsi pc fn2-pool)) (<= n (fn2-pool-class-countsi sc fn2-pool)))))))
run-physical-geometry.lisp:
; Immutable initializer geometry for the physical C loader. The profile,
; rather than an adoption caller, assigns its cursor and checker regions.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "run-physical-resources")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(defcolumns fn2-run-load-geometry
 ((version :u8) (cursors :u32) (transactions :u32) (reads :u32) (operations :u32)
  (uploads :u32) (controls :u32) (prefix :u32) (format-rows :u32) (field-rows :u32) (digest-rows :u32)))
(defcolumns fn2-run-load-readiness
 ((phase (:enum fn2-run-load-readiness-phase (:idle :cursors :operations :complete :refused)))
  (scope (:enum fn2-run-load-readiness-scope (:cold :live))) (cut-commit :u60) (cut-event :u60)
  (tag :u60) (selected-generation :u60) (candidate :u32)
  (owner-kind :u8) (owner-slot :u32) (owner-gen :u60)
  (admissions :u60) (row :u32) (cursor-end :u32)))

(defun fn2-run-load-geometry-profilep (profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-profile-t profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-read-rows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-profile-o profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-upload-windows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-ctl-rows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ 4 (fn2-b-upload-windows profile)))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-format-slots profile))
      (<= (fn2-b-format-floor profile) (fn2-b-format-slots profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :format-field-slots (fn2-b-field-rows profile) profile))
      (<= (fn2-b-field-rows profile) (fn2-b-capacity :format-field-slots (fn2-b-field-rows profile) profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :digest-slots (fn2-b-digest-minimum profile) profile))
      (<= (fn2-b-digest-minimum profile) (fn2-b-capacity :digest-slots (fn2-b-digest-minimum profile) profile))))
(defun fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init (profile fn2-run-load-geometry)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-load-geometry :guard t))
 (let ((fn2-run-load-geometry (fn2-run-load-geometry-init 1 fn2-run-load-geometry)))
  (if (not (fn2-run-load-geometry-profilep profile)) fn2-run-load-geometry
   (fn2-run-load-geometry-put 0 (version 1) (cursors (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile))
    (transactions (fn2-profile-t profile)) (reads (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) (operations (fn2-profile-o profile))
    (uploads (fn2-b-upload-windows profile)) (controls (fn2-b-ctl-rows profile))
    (prefix (+ 4 (fn2-b-upload-windows profile))) (format-rows (fn2-b-format-slots profile))
    (field-rows (fn2-b-capacity :format-field-slots (fn2-b-field-rows profile) profile))
    (digest-rows (fn2-b-capacity :digest-slots (fn2-b-digest-minimum profile) profile))))))
; Only the real core initializer calls PROFILE-INIT. No served operation
; writes this carrier; callbacks consume it as a readonly child.
(fn2-run-load-geometry-preserves fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init
 (profile fn2-run-load-geometry) :position nil
 :hyps ((fn2-run-load-geometryp fn2-run-load-geometry))
 :specs (("-TYPE" fn2-run-load-geometryp nil) ("-WFP" fn2-run-load-geometry-wfp nil)))
(defthm fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init-rows
 (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-rows (fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init profile fn2-run-load-geometry)) 1)
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init))))
(defthm fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init-cursors
 (implies (fn2-run-load-geometry-profilep profile)
  (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-cursors 0 (fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init profile fn2-run-load-geometry))
         (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile)))
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init))))
run-physical-readiness.lisp:
; Cold bounded capability preflight. Each step validates one initialized
; cursor stripe or one operation-routing row; EOF is retained with selected
; identity and the actual loader admissions serial. This is not adoption
; authority or a promise of capacity after later actors start reserving it.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-read")
(include-book "run-physical-geometry")
(include-book "run-physical-release")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(defmacro fn2-run-load-readiness-guard ()
 '(and (fn2-run-load-readiness-wfp fn2-run-load-readiness) (fn2-run-load-geometry-wfp fn2-run-load-geometry)
       (fn2-id-decides-wfp fn2-id-decides) (fn2-reads-wfp fn2-reads) (fn2-run-loads-wfp fn2-run-loads)
       (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
       (fn2-run-load-ops-wfp fn2-run-load-ops) (fn2-ops-wfp fn2-ops) (fn2-fc-wfp fn2-fc)
       (fn2-fc-context-wfp fn2-fc-context) (fn2-b3-wfp fn2-b3) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)
       (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))

; Dimension equality uses actual initialized request tables, not a count
; supplied by the cold caller. Private rows occupy the fixed prefix after
; commit/recovery/upload/sealer, strictly before controls and the last five.
(defun fn2-run-load-geometry-current-p (fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-id-decides fn2-reads fn2-run-loads
 fn2-run-cursors fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-run-load-ops fn2-ops fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-id-decides fn2-reads fn2-run-loads fn2-run-cursors fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-run-load-ops fn2-ops fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests)
 :guard (and (fn2-run-load-geometry-wfp fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-id-decides-wfp fn2-id-decides) (fn2-reads-wfp fn2-reads)
  (fn2-run-loads-wfp fn2-run-loads) (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
  (fn2-run-load-ops-wfp fn2-run-load-ops) (fn2-ops-wfp fn2-ops) (fn2-fc-wfp fn2-fc) (fn2-fc-context-wfp fn2-fc-context)
  (fn2-b3-wfp fn2-b3) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests))))
 (and (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-rows fn2-run-load-geometry) 1)
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-version 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) 1)
      (unsigned-byte-p 60 (+ 1 (fn2-run-loads-admissions fn2-run-loads)))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-transactions 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-reads 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-reads-rows fn2-reads))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-cursors 0 fn2-run-load-geometry)
       (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows-from-counts (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides) (fn2-reads-rows fn2-reads)))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-cursors 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads))
      (equal (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads) (fn2-run-cursors-rows fn2-run-cursors))
      (equal (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-operations 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-ops-rows fn2-ops))
      (equal (fn2-ops-rows fn2-ops) (fn2-run-load-ops-rows fn2-run-load-ops))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-prefix 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (+ 4 (fn2-run-load-geometry-uploads 0 fn2-run-load-geometry)))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-format-rows 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc))
      (equal (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) (fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-fc-context))
      (equal (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) (fn2-b3-rows fn2-b3))
      (equal (fn2-b3-words-length fn2-b3) (* 16 (fn2-b3-rows fn2-b3)))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-field-rows 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-digest-rows 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-digests-rows fn2-digests))
      (<= (+ (fn2-run-load-geometry-prefix 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads))
          (- (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) (fn2-run-load-geometry-controls 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) 5))
      (<= (* 128 (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc)) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
      (<= (* *fn2-digest-stride* (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc)) (fn2-digests-rows fn2-digests))))

; Shared private-stripe check for initialized IDLE and actual owned PARKED
; jobs. Neither branch permits decoded physical bytes to remain exposed.
(defun fn2-run-load-readiness-stripe-p (c fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-run-loads fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-run-loads fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests)
 :guard (and (fn2-run-load-geometry-wfp fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-run-loads-wfp fn2-run-loads)
  (fn2-fc-wfp fn2-fc) (fn2-fc-context-wfp fn2-fc-context) (fn2-b3-wfp fn2-b3) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests)
  (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-rows fn2-run-load-geometry) 1) (natp c) (< c (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads)))))
 (let* ((row (+ (fn2-run-load-geometry-prefix 0 fn2-run-load-geometry) c)) (base (* 128 row)))
       (and (equal (fn2-run-loads-checker c fn2-run-loads) row)
            (< row (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc)) (< row (fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-fc-context))
            (equal (fn2-fc-phase row fn2-fc) *fn2-fc-phase-idle*)
            (fn2-b3-ready row fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
            (fn2-run-readerp base fn2-fields)
            (<= (+ base *fn2-format-sealed-batch-num-fields*) (* 128 (+ row 1)))
            (<= (+ base *fn2-run-reader-fields*) (* 128 (+ row 1)))
            (fn2-digest-rowp (fn2-digest-slot row *fn2-fc-hash*) fn2-digests)
            (fn2-digest-rowp (fn2-digest-slot row *fn2-fc-geometry*) fn2-digests)
            (fn2-digest-rowp (fn2-digest-slot row *fn2-fc-previous-seal*) fn2-digests))))

(defun fn2-run-load-readiness-one-row-p (c fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-run-loads fn2-run-cursors
 fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-run-loads fn2-run-cursors fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests)
 :guard (and (fn2-run-load-geometry-wfp fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-run-loads-wfp fn2-run-loads)
  (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
  (fn2-fc-wfp fn2-fc) (fn2-fc-context-wfp fn2-fc-context) (fn2-b3-wfp fn2-b3) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests))))
 (and (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-rows fn2-run-load-geometry) 1)
      (natp c) (< c (fn2-run-loads-rows fn2-run-loads)) (< c (fn2-run-cursors-rows fn2-run-cursors))
      (< c (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      (equal (fn2-run-loads-phase c fn2-run-loads) *fn2-run-load-phase-idle*)
      (equal (fn2-run-loads-windows c fn2-run-loads) 0) (equal (fn2-run-loads-pending c fn2-run-loads) 0)
      (equal (fn2-run-loads-kind c fn2-run-loads) 0) (equal (fn2-run-loads-owner c fn2-run-loads) 0)
      (equal (fn2-run-loads-generation c fn2-run-loads) 0)
      (equal (fn2-run-cursors-phase c fn2-run-cursors) *fn2-run-cursor-phase-idle*)
      (equal (fn2-run-cursors-physical c fn2-run-cursors) 0)
      (equal (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-live c fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) 0)
      (fn2-run-load-readiness-stripe-p c fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-run-loads fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests)))
; The caller must additionally validate this retained tuple against the
; actual machine table. This lower predicate validates concrete resources,
; not a caller-supplied readiness bit or publication authority.
(defun fn2-run-load-readiness-parked-row-p (c kind owner generation fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-run-loads fn2-run-cursors
 fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-run-loads fn2-run-cursors fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests fn2-pool)
 :guard (and (fn2-run-load-geometry-wfp fn2-run-load-geometry) (fn2-run-loads-wfp fn2-run-loads)
  (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
  (fn2-fc-wfp fn2-fc) (fn2-fc-context-wfp fn2-fc-context) (fn2-b3-wfp fn2-b3) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (and (equal (fn2-run-load-geometry-rows fn2-run-load-geometry) 1)
      (posp kind) (posp generation)
      (fn2-run-load-parkable-p c kind owner generation fn2-run-loads fn2-run-cursors fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-pool)
      (equal (fn2-run-loads-phase c fn2-run-loads) *fn2-run-load-phase-reserved*)
      (equal (fn2-run-loads-source c fn2-run-loads) *fn2-none*) (equal (fn2-run-loads-tag c fn2-run-loads) 0)
      (equal (fn2-run-cursors-phase c fn2-run-cursors) *fn2-run-cursor-phase-idle*)
      (equal (fn2-run-cursors-physical c fn2-run-cursors) 0)
      (equal (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-live c fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) 0)
      (not (equal (fn2-run-loads-page c fn2-run-loads) (fn2-run-loads-scratch c fn2-run-loads)))
      (<= *fn2-format-page-size* (fn2-pool-cap (fn2-run-loads-page c fn2-run-loads) fn2-pool))
      (<= *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* (fn2-pool-cap (fn2-run-loads-scratch c fn2-run-loads) fn2-pool))
      (fn2-run-load-readiness-stripe-p c fn2-run-load-geometry fn2-run-loads fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-digests)))

; LIVE=0 is the canonical harvest terminal. Historical generation/cursor
; remain for stale-event checking; no job pending bit may remain at scan EOF.
(defun fn2-run-load-readiness-op-quiescent-p (o fn2-run-load-ops fn2-ops)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-load-ops fn2-ops)
 :guard (and (fn2-run-load-ops-wfp fn2-run-load-ops) (fn2-ops-wfp fn2-ops))))
 (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-run-load-ops-rows fn2-run-load-ops)) (< o (fn2-ops-rows fn2-ops))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-ops-live o fn2-run-load-ops) 0)))
; Generic boot I/O may occupy an operation row without touching this routing
; map. We check the map's initialization here; ROOMP independently checks an
; actually free descriptor/credit, rather than claiming all operations idle.
(defun fn2-run-load-readiness-op-row-p (o fn2-run-load-ops fn2-ops)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-load-ops fn2-ops)
 :guard (and (fn2-run-load-ops-wfp fn2-run-load-ops) (fn2-ops-wfp fn2-ops))))
 (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-run-load-ops-rows fn2-run-load-ops)) (< o (fn2-ops-rows fn2-ops))
      (equal (fn2-run-load-ops-live o fn2-run-load-ops) 0)
      (equal (fn2-run-load-ops-generation o fn2-run-load-ops) 0)
      (equal (fn2-run-load-ops-cursor o fn2-run-load-ops) 0)))
(defun fn2-run-load-readiness-roomp (fn2-pool fn2-ops)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-pool fn2-ops) :guard (and (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-ops-wfp fn2-ops))))
 (let ((pc (fn2-pool-class-for *fn2-format-page-size* fn2-pool))
       (sc (fn2-pool-class-for *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* fn2-pool))
       (op (fn2-ops-free-head fn2-ops)))
  (and (natp pc) (< pc (fn2-pool-nclasses fn2-pool)) (natp sc) (< sc (fn2-pool-nclasses fn2-pool))
       (<= *fn2-format-page-size* (fn2-pool-class-sizesi pc fn2-pool))
       (<= *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* (fn2-pool-class-sizesi sc fn2-pool))
       (fn2-run-load-roomp *fn2-b-query-loader-jobs* fn2-pool)
       (fn2-op-slotp op fn2-ops) (equal (fn2-ops-phase op fn2-ops) *fn2-op-phase-free*)
       (< 0 (fn2-ops-outbox-credits fn2-ops)))))

(defun fn2-run-load-readiness-ownerp (tag selected-generation candidate kind owner generation fn2-run-load-readiness)
